protocol.historical_demand_replica_excluded: D11 proved route_choice_shift was another independent_paths case
protocol.selector_input: Sum of largest ceil(.15*n_paths) weak-prior values / total prior; no truth or hidden labels
protocol.selection: Maximum worst-regime dev gain then mean; tie-break less application and grid index
protocol.development_gate: Mean gain >=.005, every regime mean >=-.002, full optimizer success; else deploy Ridge .05
protocol.solver: Scaled nonnegative MAP; Gaussian or original-objective-certified Huber IRLS. Continuous prior, not discrete hurdle probability.
protocol.assessment_scope: Previously viewed seeds and data distributions; development research, not an unopened final test

source_snapshot.scope: Own source, vendored official Python and dependency locks; no data, credentials or model weights
